title: Window Options Floating Overlay
description: Window options: absolute overlay on content, per-option floating cards, pointer-events split so canvas receives clicks through empty overlay.
summary: Window body uses full-size relative column; options render in pointer-events-none absolute overlay with pointer-events-auto right-aligned stack (scroll). Each UIWindowOption (except section/separator) wrapped in UIWindowOptionFloat (rounded, shadow, blur, translucent bg). Section is compact pill; separator short tick. Tests updated for overlay + float slots.
